widgetsB.help.basics.intro: Themia puts *widgets* on your desktop: a clock, your calendar, the weather, a note. They sit on the wallpaper, under every window, and stay out of the way until you want to change something.
widgetsB.help.basics.editMode: *Edit mode* is where you change things. Press *Ctrl+Alt+W*, double-click a widget, or choose _Edit layout_ on any widget's menu. Press it again, or _Done_ on the toolbar, when you have finished.
widgetsB.help.basics.startAgain: Themia has no window and no tray icon. If another app owns the shortcut, *start Themia again*: the copy that is already running opens edit mode.
widgetsB.help.basics.rightClick: *Right-click* a widget for its menu: _Configure…_, _Copy_, _Duplicate_, _Bring to front_, _Delete_ and more.
widgetsB.help.basics.displays: Every *display* shows a view of its own, so each screen can carry a different layout.
widgetsB.help.basics.keyboardClick: Widgets never take the keyboard from the app you are in by themselves. *Click* a list, a search box or a calendar and its keys work: the arrows, *Enter*, and the *Menu* key for an item's menu.
widgetsB.help.basics.keyboardEsc: *Esc*, or a click anywhere else, hands the keyboard back to the app you were in.
widgetsB.help.basics.tip: Done with this guide? Right-click it and choose _Delete_.
widgetsB.help.widgets.intro: Every widget is a card you can place, size and set up the way you like. All of this happens in edit mode.
widgetsB.help.widgets.addPick: Choose _Add widget_ on the toolbar. *Type to search*, or browse the categories, and pick one with a click or *Enter*.
widgetsB.help.widgets.addPlace: The new widget *follows the pointer*, onto any display. Click where it should go; *Esc* or a right-click cancels.
widgetsB.help.widgets.drag: *Drag* a widget to move it, or one of its eight handles to resize it. Hold *Alt* to place it off the snap grid.
widgetsB.help.widgets.select: *Select several*: *Ctrl+click* them, or drag a box around them from an empty part of the desktop. *Ctrl+A* selects every widget on the display.
widgetsB.help.widgets.selectionActs: Dragging, deleting, copying and layering act on everything selected.
widgetsB.help.widgets.clipboard: *Ctrl+C*, *Ctrl+X* and *Ctrl+V* copy, cut and paste; *Ctrl+D* duplicates. A paste, a duplicate and _Move_ follow the pointer too, until you click.
widgetsB.help.widgets.layering: _Bring to front_ and _Send to back_ decide which of two overlapping widgets is on top.
widgetsB.help.widgets.deleteEsc: *Delete* removes what is selected. *Esc* clears the selection, and a second *Esc* leaves edit mode.
widgetsB.help.widgets.containerKinds: A *Group* draws one frame behind the widgets in it, a *Stack* lists them as rows that open and close, and *Tabs* shows one at a time.
widgetsB.help.widgets.containerDrop: Drop a widget onto a container to put it in, or use _Move into_ on its menu. _Add widget inside…_ on a container's menu creates one there.
widgetsB.help.widgets.containerDelete: Deleting a container keeps the widgets that were in it.
widgetsB.help.widgets.kindsTime: *Time*: clocks, countdowns, a focus timer, sun and moon.
widgetsB.help.widgets.kindsMail: *Mail & calendar*: mail, events, tasks, contacts and files from the accounts you add in _Settings_, under _Accounts_.
widgetsB.help.widgets.kindsSystem: *System*: processor, memory, disks, network, volume and more.
widgetsB.help.widgets.kindsInfo: *Information*, *Media* and *Launch*: weather, feeds, music, pictures, apps and shortcuts.
widgetsB.help.widgets.kindsDesk: *Desk*, *Trackers* and *Layout*: notes, habits and mood, and the containers above.
widgetsB.help.views.intro: A *view* is a whole desktop layout. Keep one for work and one for the evening, and switch between them in one go.
widgetsB.help.views.viewBar: The *view bar*, at the bottom left of each display, lists your views: click one to put it on that display.
widgetsB.help.views.viewMenu: In edit mode the _View_ menu on the toolbar does the same, and *Ctrl+1* to *Ctrl+9* show the first nine views.
widgetsB.help.views.switcher: Or add a *View switcher* widget wherever you like.
widgetsB.help.views.perDisplay: Each display remembers its own view, so two screens can show two layouts.
widgetsB.help.views.barDrag: In edit mode, *drag* the bar to a corner or the middle of an edge, drag a view along it to change the order, or right-click a view to duplicate it or open its settings.
widgetsB.help.views.barSettings: Whether the bar shows, where, how big, with or without names, and which views it offers: _Settings_, on the display's page.
widgetsB.help.views.manageNew: _New view_ and _Duplicate this view_ are at the bottom of the _View_ menu.
widgetsB.help.views.manageRename: Rename a view, give it an icon or delete it in _Settings_, on the view's page.
widgetsB.help.views.manageMove: Drag a widget onto another display to move it into the view that display is showing.
widgetsB.help.customize.intro: _Settings_, on the edit toolbar, is where the look of every widget lives.
widgetsB.help.customize.findBox: Type into *Find a setting*, at the top of the Settings window. It searches every page, every view and every widget you use.
widgetsB.help.customize.theme: *Theme*: light, dark, or the same as Windows.
widgetsB.help.customize.colours: *Colours*: the accent and the widget background. Leave them empty to follow the theme.
widgetsB.help.customize.shape: *Shape*: corner radius, border and opacity, for every widget at once.
widgetsB.help.customize.textSize: *Font*, *text size* and *widget scale* make everything easier to read without moving anything.
widgetsB.help.customize.gapSnap: *Gap between widgets* and *snap to grid*, under _Layout_; _Snap_ on the edit toolbar turns the grid on and off.
widgetsB.help.customize.perWidget: Each widget's own _Configure…_ page also says where its header sits and how its card is filled.
